SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: GlobalQualityWeight is consumed as a continuous 0..1 scalar. Below q=0.22 the active and legacy fragment shaders sample only the primary view frame and skip secondary-view atlas reads. Between q=0.22 and q=0.55, smoothstep restores interpolation weight continuously. Bake/mock math collapses toward cheaper silhouettes, smaller radii, lower view complexity, earlier impostor swap distance through ResolveContinuousEnterDistanceMeters, and shader interpolation bias toward the cheaper frame selection. Middle weights keep 16-view atlases and dithered transitions. High and Ultra spend saved geometry time on larger atlases, more views, stronger dilation, longer real-geometry residency, and richer normal/depth fidelity. No SHINOBU runtime path now reads GlobalRegistry.ScalabilityTier in Tick; culling tier is only a quantized adapter for the existing culling enum, derived from the continuous weight.

H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.PRIVATE_NATIVE_ARRAYS: The previous renderer-owned NativeArray upload cache was removed. Runtime upload writes either the provided NativeArray directly or writes straight into GraphicsBuffer.LockBufferForWrite.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.RUNTIME_FALLBACK_ALLOCATIONS: The renderer no longer creates fallback Mesh, Material, shader lookup, or managed quad arrays at runtime. The baker must output the quad mesh and material; missing assets fail closed by not drawing.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.AUP_OFFSET_AUTHORITY: The renderer resolves floating offset through HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffset and no longer reads HectonMapMagicVegetationBridge.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.MATERIAL_CHURN: Static atlas/material metadata refresh is dirty-gated by material/data identity; _GlobalFloatingOffset writes are gated by material or origin-shift/value change.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.EDITOR_NATIVE_ARRAYS: Forge preview now allocates NativeArray records only as TempJob scratch and disposes in the same call; profile and preview caches are editor-managed arrays outside gameplay hot paths.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.VAULT_HANDLES: No VaultBufferHandle is requested because SHINOBU owns offline Editor bake artifacts and GPU presentation buffers only. It owns no authoritative gameplay fact, rollback state, or cross-domain persistent simulation memory.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.LIFECYCLE: RenderTextures and GraphicsBuffers are explicitly released; temporary native arrays in editor bake scopes use TempJob and dispose after readback/job completion.

SELF_AUDIT.COMPILE_GUARD: SHINOBU did not create or modify asmdef dependencies. Runtime communication uses existing Core contracts/registry interfaces and the core floating-origin authority. Shader material dynamic fields now sit inside UnityPerMaterial CBUFFER in active and legacy impostor shaders. No direct new sibling Runtime assembly reference was introduced. Compile/import proof is pending because CPU gate is still active.
SELF_AUDIT.EDITOR_CAPTURE_BOUNDARY: RenderWithShader remains only inside the Editor baker capture function. Static archaeology now scans runtime Rendering and Environment directories for RenderWithShader in addition to Camera.Render, ReadPixels, and EncodeToPNG. Runtime generation of captures remains forbidden.
SELF_AUDIT.DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION: Before: far giant object rendering costs O(V) vertex processing plus material/overdraw per mesh every frame, where V is original mesh vertex count. After: runtime costs O(1) quad vertices per impostor plus O(K) atlas samples per shaded pixel, with K collapsing toward one/two samples under low GlobalQualityWeight. Heavy capture, packing, dilation, and PNG serialization move to offline Editor time.
